title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
scope: General structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and civil structures.
test_methods: IS 516 (Methods of Tests for Strength of Concrete)
IS 1199 (Sampling and Analysis of Concrete)
safety_standards: IS 14489 (Code of Practice on Occupational Safety and Health Audit)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Standard practice compliance required for government tenders.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: Specifies requirements for deformed steel bars (TMT rebars Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, Fe 600, Fe 500D) for reinforcement.
test_methods: IS 1608 (Part 1) (Tensile Testing of Metallic Materials)
IS 1599 (Metallic Materials - Bend Test)
IS 228 (Chemical Analysis of Steels)
installation_standards: IS 2502 (Code of Practice for Bending and Fixing of Bars for Concrete Reinforcement)

mandatory_qco.order_number: S.O. 1225(E) Steel and Steel Products QCO
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory ISI Mark under Scheme I. Bidders must produce valid CML license copy.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade - Specification
scope: Specifies chemical and physical requirements for 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement.
test_methods: IS 4031 (Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement)
IS 4032 (Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement)

mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS ISI certification. Manufacturer must hold valid BIS license.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for HDPE pipes (PE 63, PE 80, PE 100) for underground water supply networks.
test_methods: IS 12235 (Methods of Test for Unplasticized PVC / Polyethylene Pipes)
IS 2530 (Methods of Test for Polyethylene)
installation_standards: IS 7634 (Part 2) (Code of Practice for Laying and Jointing of Polyethylene Pipes)

mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Pipes must bear ISI mark with manufacturer CML number.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars (Outdated / Superseded)
scope: Superseded older edition of TMT steel bar specification.

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: OUTDATED: Do not use in new tenders.

title: Outdoor Type Three-Phase Distribution Transformers Up to and Including 2500 kVA, 33 kV
scope: Specifies standard ratings, maximum allowable losses (Energy Efficiency Level 1/2/3), and tests for distribution transformers.
key_parameters: No-load Loss & Load Loss at 50% / 100% load
Temperature Rise Limit (Winding 55 deg C, Oil 50 deg C)
Insulation Level (LI 170 kV, AC 70 kV for 33kV)
test_methods: IS 2026 (Power Transformers - General & Temperature Rise Tests)
IS 335 (New Insulating Oils - Specification & Breakdown Voltage)
IS 6600 (Guide for Loading of Oil Immersed Transformers)
safety_standards: IS 1646 (Code of Practice for Fire Safety of Buildings - Electrical Installations)
installation_standards: IS 10028 (Part 1, 2, 3) (Code of Practice for Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Transformers)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS ISI Mark and BEE Star Rating Label (BEE Gazette S.O. 3338E).

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V - Specification
scope: Single-core and multi-core PVC insulated and sheathed flexible and non-flexible copper/aluminium wires for electric power and lighting.
test_methods: IS 10810 (Methods of Test for Cables - Part 0 to 64)
IS 8130 (Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables)
IS 5831 (PVC Insulation and Sheath of Electric Cables)
safety_standards: IS 732 (Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations)

mandatory_qco.order_number: S.O. 4330(E) Electrical Wires and Cables QCO
mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory ISI Mark. Uncertified cables prohibited from government tenders.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Related Voltages Up to and Including 250 Volts and Rated Current Up to and Including 16 Amperes - Specification
scope: Specifies safety, dimensional, and endurance requirements for domestic and commercial 6A / 16A plugs and socket outlets.
key_parameters: Glow Wire Test at 750 deg C
test_methods: IS 1293 Clause 13 to Clause 28 (Endurance and Safety Tests)
installation_standards: IS 732 (Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations)

mandatory_qco.order_number: S.O. 4381(E) Plugs and Socket Outlets QCO
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory ISI Mark certification under BIS Scheme I.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets (Outdated / Superseded 2005 Edition)
scope: Outdated 2005 edition of Plugs and Sockets standard without revised safety shutters.
key_parameters: Obsolete pin dimensions and non-shuttered requirements

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: SUPERSEDED: Must be updated to IS 1293:2019 in all active tenders.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Design qualification and type approval of terrestrial PV modules for long-term outdoor operation.
test_methods: IS/IEC 61215-2 (Terrestrial PV Modules - Test Procedures)
IS/IEC 60904 (Photovoltaic Devices - Measurement of PV Current-Voltage)

mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS Registration (CRS Scheme II / ALMM Listing by MNRE).

title: Safety of Power Converters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Particular Requirements for Inverters
scope: Specifies electrical and fire safety requirements for grid-connected and off-grid solar inverters.
test_methods: IS 16169 (Test Procedure of Islanding Prevention Measures)
IS/IEC 60068 (Environmental Testing)
safety_standards: IS 16221 (Part 1) (General Safety Requirements for Power Converters)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS CRS registration and MNRE guidelines compliance.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Safety of mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment including laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers.
test_methods: IS 13252 (Part 1) Clause 5 (Electrical Tests)

mandatory_qco.order_number: S.O. 2357(E) Electronics and IT Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order
mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS CRS Registration Number (R-XXXXXXXX) prominently marked on product and packaging.

title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
scope: Safety and constructional requirements for LED street light luminaires, highway lighting, and public space poles.
test_methods: IS 16103 (Part 1 & 2) (LED Modules for General Lighting)
IS 16107 (Part 2/Sec 1) (Photometric Testing)
safety_standards: IS 15885 (Part 2/Sec 13) (Safety of Lamp Controlgear - LED Drivers)
installation_standards: IS 1944 (Code of Practice for Lighting of Public Thoroughfares)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS CRS Registration for LED Luminaire and Driver.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction - Specification
scope: Specifies construction, minimum fire rating (Class A, B, C, D, F), burst pressure, and safety discharge of portable fire extinguishers.
test_methods: IS 15683 Annexure A to G (Fire Test Protocols)
IS 4308 (Specification for Dry Chemical Powder for Fire Fighting)
safety_standards: IS 2190 (Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Portable First-Aid Fire Extinguishers - Code of Practice)
installation_standards: IS 2190 (Code of Practice for Fire Extinguisher Installation)

mandatory_qco.issuing_ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory ISI Mark certification under BIS Scheme I.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for particle filtering half masks (FFP1, FFP2 / N95 equivalent, FFP3) used as respiratory protective devices.
test_methods: IS 9473 Clause 8 (Sodium Chloride & Paraffin Oil Aerosol Test)
IS 9473 Clause 9 (Breathing Resistance Test)
safety_standards: IS 9623 (Code of Practice for Selection, Use and Maintenance of Respiratory Protective Devices)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory BIS ISI Mark certification on every packaging box and mask.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: Specifies physical, shock absorption, penetration resistance, flammability, and electrical resistance for industrial safety helmets.
test_methods: IS 2925 Appendix A to G (Mechanical & Electrical Test Methods)
installation_standards: IS 13415 (Code of Practice for Selection and Care of Industrial Safety Helmets)

mandatory_qco.clause_requirement: Mandatory ISI Mark certification. Helmets without valid CML license rejected.
